The Lion Sleeps Tonight

Rules:

• Normal Sudoku rules apply.

• Normal rules for renban (purple), Region Sum Lines (blue), and killer cages apply.

• Renban Lines: The purple lines in the grid are renban lines. Digits on a line form a set of non-repeating, consecutive digits in any order.

• Region Sum Lines: Box borders divide blue lines into segments. The sum of digits along each segment is the same. Different lines may have different sums.

• Killer Cages: Digits in cages do not repeat and sum to the given total.
